set.body: Follow-up to bd-01M44W2HXQ5PY3YE33D5W37A04 (PR #37). atlasJVM tests currently depend on surface.jvm % "test->test" to reach the real-asset fsLR fixtures (locked asset gate, SimpleITK inverse oracle, qualification inputs) that live in surface's JVM tests. Owner accepted this test-only edge on 2026-10-10 (no cycle: surface does not depend on atlas). Longer term, move those fixtures into a small shared test-fixtures module that both surface and atlas tests depend on, and drop the test->test edge. JVM+JS where applicable; warning-clean.
set.title: Move real-asset fsLR fixtures into a shared test-fixtures module
